caption: The drawing depicts two objects that appear to be protective gear, likely made of metal and leather. The object on the left consists of a brown, slightly trapezoidal main piece with a lighter brown strap and a rectangular flap attached to its upper left side. The main piece has a weathered metallic surface and is fastened with brown leather straps that are buckled and extend outward. The object on the right is shaped like a curved, elongated shell with a ridged, metallic surface and is attached to a similarly brown leather strap. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown and gray, with fine lines and shading to suggest texture and material differences. The drawing is placed against a plain, beige background, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Snow Skates
